title: Ansel and the Signal
author: Orsen Villalobos
blurb: Jude Yarrow, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
